staggeredMagneticField.convention: Bx at(i*dx,(j+.5)*dy), By at((i+.5)*dx,j*dy); periodic arrays with nx*ny faces per component.

iron.scope: Approximate isobaric iron enthalpy laboratory. Constant heat capacities and declared latent heats; no expansion, solid mechanics, pressure-dependent phase diagram or black-hole cover inference. LTE first-ionization partition is a reference diagnostic and does not enter enthalpy.

constants.scope: Approximate isobaric iron enthalpy laboratory. Constant heat capacities and declared latent heats; no expansion, solid mechanics, pressure-dependent phase diagram or black-hole cover inference. LTE first-ionization partition is a reference diagnostic and does not enter enthalpy.

diagnostics.method: First-order Rusanov finite-volume fluxes; shared-corner constrained transport; SSP RK2; CFL/diffusion/reaction limits with rejected positivity steps. Numerical diffusion is present and must be tested by refinement.
diagnostics.criteria: Periodic global mass and total MHD energy relative residual<1e-8; normalized staggered divergence<1e-10; finite positive density/pressure/material temperature. Passing is numerical consistency, not empirical validation.

conventions.complex: Counterclockwise wrapped phase differences around four cell-center corners; location is plaquette center, not a subcell fitted vortex. Undefined/near-pi edge samples are flagged unresolved.
conventions.phaseUndefined: Phase set to0 solely for JSON-safe transport; phaseDefined/magneticPhaseDefined mark undefined low-amplitude cells.
conventions.materialPartition: solid+liquid+neutral vapor+first-ionized plasma fractions sum to1. Plasma is a diagnostic partition of vapor, not an extra fraction or latent heat source.
conventions.reset: Changing any parameter reinitializes the deterministic experiment at time0. Custom initial-condition callback is a trusted local testing interface and is never accepted over HTTP.

scopes.mhd: Computed 2D Cartesian periodic compressible nonrelativistic ideal-gas MHD with resistive, viscous and heat-conduction fluxes. Fixed gamma=5/3, mean molecular weight=0.5. No relativistic plasma, Kerr gravity, accretion, radiation or solid cover dynamics.
scopes.complexPhase: Computed neutral advected cubic complex Ginzburg-Landau field. Plasma temperature, density and magnetic energy alter declared phenomenological growth coefficients. One-way coupling; this is not a quantum condensate, charged wavefunction or measured astronomical phase.
scopes.magneticPhase: arg(Bx+i By) is in-plane magnetic direction. Field zeros and plaquette winding indicators are finite-grid measurements; no flux quantization or superconducting interpretation.
scopes.ionization: Hydrogen LTE ground-state Saha reference at local temperature and nuclei density. Ionization energy and variable particle number do not alter the fixed MHD ideal-gas EOS. LTE is not established here and this diagnostic is not valid evidence for optically thin EHT plasma.
scopes.iron: Approximate isobaric iron enthalpy laboratory. Constant heat capacities and declared latent heats; no expansion, solid mechanics, pressure-dependent phase diagram or black-hole cover inference. LTE first-ionization partition is a reference diagnostic and does not enter enthalpy.
scopes.geometry: The local periodic patch and separate iron parcel grid can be displayed near the aperture/aggie illustration. This mapping is a display choice; no near-horizon spacetime or actual condensed surface is solved.
